why_agent_cannot: an X account post or follow is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Lora Finance site Go to the Lora Finance home page to see the product description and the assets section.
2 Step 2 : Read the four stages The page walks through picking an asset, setting your sell price, collecting upfront and settling on-chain. Read them to see what a position involves.
3 Step 3 : Join the waitlist Use the waitlist page to sign up for V2 access, which the site says is coming soon.
4 Step 4 : Find the project on X The Lora Finance account on X is the project's X account.
